title: Choose the home page structure
question: Three ways to build the new home page around a live lead pipeline, all in the current YMG brand. Lock one, steer it, or re-roll.

options.label: The Missed Call
options.lineage: A real intake moment: the after-hours call most firms never answer
options.thesis: The pipeline starts where firms lose cases: an unanswered call, then YMG answers it.
options.viewport: Headline left, a ringing sample call card right with the 48% stat, and the five pipeline stages across the bottom.
options.risk: Leans on the problem; the stat must stay sourced and the call card clearly labelled as a sample.

raised.raise: The five stages are identical units in one row, read in a single sweep, so progress shows at a glance.

options.label: The Criteria Builder
options.lineage: YMG's positioning: campaigns built on the firm's own criteria
options.thesis: The partner picks practice area, markets and delivery, and a matching sample lead appears.
options.viewport: Headline left; a working 'What cases does your firm want?' panel right that ends in 'Talk to YMG Legal about this campaign'.
options.risk: Interactive hero needs real care on mobile and must never read as a price quote or guarantee.

options.label: The Case File
options.lineage: The intake file a firm actually receives
options.thesis: One sample case file stays beside the page and completes stage by stage as you scroll.
options.viewport: Large headline left; a tabbed sample file right with fields, criteria checks, a QUALIFIED stamp and stage progress.
options.risk: The sticky file must not crowd small screens; on phones it becomes one card per section.
